title: Five years of psychokinesis experiments could never isolate the target
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Five years of psychokinesis experiments could never isolate the target, about unspecified (five years, research lab era) at research lab (not named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we did uh five years of experiments to prove psychokinesis

plain: A man named Joe McMoneagle, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says he took part in five years of experiments at a research lab meant to prove psychokinesis, the idea that the mind can move or affect objects. According to him, the researchers could never isolate the target of the effect, so the work never gave a clean proof.
